answer: Sample one in twenty attestations each epoch and re-run the work, and if a sample fails, reset the identity's standing to zero instead of docking it. Any attempt to link two identities resets both, so a farmer who merges accounts to save effort loses the history they merged. A recruiter cannot grade its own recruit either, which keeps the ember of a bad reference from passing down a thread. One failed sample costs more than the epoch earned, and a zephyr of new accounts starts at zero.
